summary: Spec fidelity: (1) brief F1 and contract 6.9 (1.2: 'the exceptions are exactly' json, limit, all, cursor, fields) leave out five names; the crate leaves out a sixth, input (LEFT_OUT_11 and _12), because the --input document's keys are already in the list. Sensible and stated in the CHANGELOG, but it is a rule the brief does not list and a tool in another language reading 6.9 literally would bind --input. (2) The brief binds 'the argument object'; the crate digests {arguments, flagOnly, environment, rules}, so equal bindings across tools hold only for tools using this crate until that shape is written down for the atip repo. (3) Scenario 01 pins the shape by hashing a document typed in the test (computed expected value), not a literal hex digest, so a change of hex() or of the shape together with the test would pass. Blast radius: cursors issued before canon moves onto this crate are ARGUMENTS_CHANGED/FOREIGN, as the brief accepts.
